# Review: 9ea9f1e62275

Status: **routine reviewer-ready return; owner acceptance remains pending**.
Source: imported generator `2.0.0` repaired to `3.0.0`; canonical rule hash `caf596654388`.
Defect → repair: missing rule hash, padding-sensitive frame checks, and non-strict overrides → literal hash, structural frame parser, strict observable axes, deterministic generation, and regressions.
Parametric build: one native three-setting metric family (`manhattan`, `chebyshev`, `euclidean_sq`) with 2–6 demonstrations and exactly four sequentially hidden queries.
Canonical preservation: `manhattan` uses the byte-for-byte canonical Racket program (`3b3a4022777068e516df22aea97e4c1515bcf1844bc6830223fb5d7903115450`); shared canonical authority was not changed.
Focused checks: 14/14 task tests, native lint, selfcheck, and rule-smoke passed.
Adversarial checks: 96 seeds, 960 scenes, 5,760 crossed controls, 876 metric signatures, 33 distinct 30×30 frame boxes, and six protected-Racket certificates passed.
Native evidence: authoring preflight passed 6 jobs / 36 parametric pairs / 60 protected-Racket evaluations; a three-case source-bound causal witness replayed successfully.
Export evidence: 24 one-query public files passed structure checks; six first turns passed 36 private-field invariance checks and six positive controls.
Limit: the standalone override battery was interrupted after 1,000/4,140 zero-finding draws and is not claimed complete; owner source review, qualification, acceptance, and training admission were not performed.

## What changed

The base generator now discovers the actual rectangular color-1 frame wherever it lies in zero padding, validates literal ARC cell types, realizes strict `grid_h`, `grid_w`, and `n_seeds` overrides, exposes exact override observations, and deterministically samples varied frame/seed layouts. The canonical output rule remains Manhattan nearest-seed fill with black cross-color ties.

The task-local parametric adapter selects one of three protected-Racket programs. Every setting receives matched inputs. Two constructive demonstrations eliminate both alternate metrics and seven named shortcut classes per metric. Four query roles cover 30×30 stress, thin-wide and tall-narrow geometry, boundary contact, multiple seeds, and visible metric-specific ties.

previous_catalog_record.summary: Single color-1 frame with seed cells inside (distinct colors). Rule Voronoi-fills the frame interior: each interior cell takes the color of the nearest seed (Manhattan); ties stay 0.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent table of per-cell distance vectors, minima, and minimizing seed-color sets.
sequential_dependency.step_a: For every non-border interior cell, compute its distance to every colored seed under the episode-fixed metric.
sequential_dependency.step_b: For each cell, paint the sole minimizing seed color; when multiple seed colors attain the minimum, paint black.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B cannot choose a color or detect a tie until step A determines which seed colors attain the metric-specific minimum; replacing those vectors with another metric changes the final partition.
